name: Priests
overview: Scripture reveals the role of priests as mediators who offer sacrifices and lead worship, as seen in the examples of Cain and Abel bringing offerings to the LORD (Genesis 4:3-4) and Noah building an altar for burnt offerings (Genesis 8:20). The establishment of altars and calling upon the name of the LORD, as Abraham did at Bethel (Genesis 12:8) and Jacob at Elbethel (Genesis 35:7), underscores the priestly responsibility to maintain a place of encounter with God. Additionally, the consecration of the firstborn and offerings to the LORD, such as setting apart the males from the firstborn of beasts (Exodus 13:12), points to the sacred duties entrusted to priests in upholding God's covenant and holiness among His people.
